name: Firebase
how_to_set: Stay on the Spark plan (hard free limits) until you need Blaze.
Blaze: it bills through Google Cloud; set a budget and the billing-disable function exactly as for gcp (fk budget plan gcp <usd>).
kill_switch: Same as Google Cloud: budget Pub/Sub function unlinks billing.
traps: Firestore read loops from client listeners
No App Check, so abuse runs up usage
